## Operators and conditions

SELECT CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) / 0
=> null

SELECT 1 / CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64)
=> null

SELECT LEFT('abc', CAST(RAND() * 0 AS INT64) + 2)
=> "ab"

## NaN compares unequal to everything, itself included

SELECT x = x FROM UNNEST([CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64)]) AS x
=> "false"

SELECT x != x FROM UNNEST([CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64)]) AS x
=> "true"

SELECT x >= 0 FROM UNNEST([CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64)]) AS x
=> "false"

SELECT x > CAST('-inf' AS FLOAT64) FROM UNNEST([CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64)]) AS x
=> "false"

SELECT 1 < x FROM UNNEST([CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64)]) AS x
=> "false"

SELECT x BETWEEN CAST('-inf' AS FLOAT64) AND CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64)
FROM UNNEST([CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64)]) AS x
=> "false"

SELECT x = CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) FROM UNNEST([CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64)]) AS x
=> null

SELECT x != CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) FROM UNNEST([CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64)]) AS x
=> null

SELECT x < 2 FROM UNNEST([1.5]) AS x
=> "true"

## LIKE escapes with a backslash

SELECT x LIKE 'ab\\%' FROM UNNEST(['ab\\xx']) AS x
=> "false"

SELECT x LIKE 'ab\\%' FROM UNNEST(['ab%']) AS x
=> "true"

SELECT x LIKE 'ab\\_' FROM UNNEST(['ab\\_']) AS x
=> "false"

SELECT x LIKE 'a\\\\%c' FROM UNNEST(['a\\c']) AS x
=> "true"

SELECT x LIKE '\\a' FROM UNNEST(['a']) AS x
=> "true"

SELECT x LIKE 'a%c' FROM UNNEST(['a\nc']) AS x
=> "true"

SELECT x LIKE CAST(NULL AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(['a']) AS x
=> null
